questions.text: Should a patient whose next Scheduled appointment is with an Inactive doctor, or a patient who is Inactive, still show that appointment in the Next appointment column?

rubric_items.reason: All seven acceptance criteria map to REQ-1..REQ-11, and AC6 is split into REQ-8/9/10. Sorting by the new column and PAT-8 are listed under Out of scope with reasons.
Each REQ states one behaviour that a tester can check, such as the column title, the selection rule, "None", the link and 20 per page.
Every known REQ cites a ticket line or a baseline/glossary anchor. The only assumed item, REQ-12, has a stated basis from L21-L22. Nothing is invented: the date-time format is left as an unknown.
The ticket does not conflict with the baseline. The time zone and the no-medical-history-in-lists rule both agree with the baseline, and the artifact says so.
All three questions are correctly non-blocking, give real options and defaults, and the format question goes to the product owner. Q-03 bundles six glossary terms into one question.
Plain wording, and Scheduled, No-show and Medical history are used the same way the glossary uses them.
